proposed_capability: One household income goal allocates one next verified profitable action across the whole observed roster. Reuse welfare, career, household budget and queue controls.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only forecast. Existing player, needs, school, career, pause and save protections retain their gates.
expected_outcome: Canonical income catalog and one action or portrait re-observation at a time, with verified safe time, queue capacity, shared equipment and total upfront commitments.
negative_tests: Never cancel or displace player work or career/needs commitments.
Never reserve the same station or action twice or bank hypothetical income.
Small business is discovery-only until location, activities, roles and receipts are available.
rollback_path: Revert the source-only commits. No game state is modified.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build native sensors, portrait switching, queue submit and funds/production receipts require the authorized local game.

sixth_gear_p141.selected_thesis: Add the shared goal to the existing household allocator with actual economics from source owners.
alternatives: Global queue override rejected because it bypasses needs/career/player decisions.
Independent per-Sim income goals rejected because they cannot share reserves, stations or obligations.
Small business execution deferred until venue controls and settlement evidence exist.
sixth_gear_p141.bounded_investigation: Validate a budget-backed, queue-bound single next effect plus portable catalog.
